answer_1.quote: Our work builds on this challenge, using the JAMA Clinical Challenge dataset, which provides real-world, complex medical cases along with MCQs and explanations (XPLs), allowing us to evaluate the decision-making rationale behind clinical-decision making with LLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate both multiple-choice answers and clinical explanations (XPLs) for complex medical cases.

answer_2.quote: We calculate accuracy scores across dimensions like gender, ethnicity, model type, and prompt variations... We employed statistical metrics to quantify bias: i) The Equality of Odds (EO) metric... ii) the SkewSize metric... iii) the Coefficient of Variation (CV)... We also calculated... SHAP values... We evaluated the models' explanations through their sentence embeddings... using the SBERT model.
